title: Stock trading with cooldown
prompt: The input is a list of daily stock prices (non-negative). You may complete any number of transactions, each buying one share on one day and selling it on a later day, but you can hold at most one share at a time, and after selling on day d you cannot buy on day d+1 (one day of cooldown). Return the maximum total profit. Doing nothing gives profit 0, so the answer is never negative; for the empty list it is 0.
